configuration.title: Damocles
configuration.permissionMode.default: Standard behavior - prompts for dangerous operations
configuration.permissionMode.auto: Auto mode - model classifier approves/denies tool permissions
configuration.model.description: Claude model to use (empty for default). Examples: claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-fable-5-1
configuration.maxBudgetUsd.description: Maximum budget in USD per session (null for unlimited)
configuration.taskBudget.description: Token budget for the model to pace tool use (alpha). Set to null to disable.
configuration.thinkingDisabled.descripti: Disable thinking on models that can run without it; models that always think, and OpenAI models, ignore it. Default: false.
configuration.effortByModel.description: Per-model reasoning effort overrides. Keyed by model id (e.g. "claude-opus-5-5"). Values: none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultracode. Supported levels vary by model: the Anthropic models (Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5) support low through ultracode; GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna support low through max; Step 5 Preview supports low, medium and high; DeepSeek V4 Pro supports high and max; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash supports low, high and max. Unsupported levels are ignored for that model. At a given level Opus 5.5 thinks more per turn than Opus 5 did, so keep xhigh and max for work where a quality gain has been measured.
configuration.enableFileCheckpointing.de: Enable file checkpointing for undo/rewind functionality
Delete a session's file checkpoint (undo/rewind) history after this many days of inactivity to reclaim disk space. Checkpoint repos are always compacted; this setting controls only deletion. Set to 0 to keep checkpoint history forever.
configuration.checkpoints.baselineWaitSe: How long a file-changing tool waits for the turn's starting checkpoint before it runs anyway. Read-only tools never wait. When the wait runs out, the tool runs and that turn cannot be rewound; the checkpoint still finishes in the background.
Files larger than this many megabytes are left out of checkpoints. A rewind never changes, deletes or restores them, and the rewind view lists them.
configuration.showCacheMissNotices.descr: Show the token and cost figures the transcript otherwise leaves out. Damocles adds an inline notice when a prompt-cache miss re-bills tokens, for example after a long idle gap. It also puts what the summarizing call billed on the compaction boundary card. Off by default.
configuration.showThinkingDroppedNotices: Show an inline notice in the transcript when Anthropic drops thinking blocks from the request because the conversation prefix changed (e.g. after you toggle plan mode or activate a tool group). On by default.
configuration.pinnedHeaderHidden.descrip: Hide the pinned user-message header above the chat. A small floating chip lets you restore it.
configuration.maxIndexedFiles.descriptio: Maximum number of files to index for @ mention autocomplete
configuration.sandbox.description: Sandbox settings for command execution isolation
configuration.sandbox.enabled.descriptio: Enable sandbox mode for Bash commands
configuration.sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCo: Allow commands that cannot be sandboxed
configuration.sandbox.networkAllowLocalB: Allow binding to local ports in sandbox
configuration.autoCompact.description: Auto-compact settings for managing context window usage
configuration.autoCompact.enabled.descri: Enable automatic context compaction when usage crosses the trigger threshold
configuration.autoCompact.triggerPercent: Compact automatically when context usage crosses this percentage of the window (default: 80%)
configuration.autoCompact.modelOverrides: Per-model auto-compact budgets. Each key is the model value shown in the model picker (e.g. "claude-opus-5-5"), and its entry applies only while that model is active. Keys are matched exactly: a retired model id is never mapped to its successor, so an entry keyed by one has no effect.
Replaces the top-level triggerPercent for this model only. Every other model keeps the top-level value.
Percentage of the context window kept as recent history when compaction runs for this model. Left unset, pi's own default applies.
configuration.cacheWarming.description: Prompt cache warming mode. Shortly before the provider drops the cached prompt, Damocles re-sends the last request with a one-token output budget whenever the expected saving is worth the cost, which resets the cache clock so the next real request is a cache read instead of a full cache rebuild. Small contexts and cheap models often miss that bar, so no warm request goes out. Each warm request is billed as a cache read of the full context plus one output token, and it never enters the conversation.
configuration.cacheWarming.off: No warming. The cache expires on the provider's schedule and the first request after that rebuilds it.
configuration.cacheWarming.streaming: Warm only while an agent run is in flight.
configuration.cacheWarming.idle: Warm while an agent run is in flight, and also while you are idle, for up to 30 minutes after the last request.
configuration.imageGeneration.enabled.de: Let the agent generate images with an OpenRouter image model and save them as new files at the path you approve (the GenerateImage tool). Each image is billed to your OpenRouter key. Read from your user settings only, so a repository cannot turn it on.
configuration.imageGeneration.model.desc: The OpenRouter image model GenerateImage uses, by its id in pi's image catalog. Empty means no model is chosen and the tool stays unavailable. Read from your user settings only, so a repository cannot choose what you are billed for.
configuration.mcp.toolExposure.descripti: Per-tool MCP control, keyed by server name and then by the tool name the server uses. "off" removes the tool, "deferred" keeps it loadable through ToolSearch, and "direct" loads it from the first turn, which costs context on every turn. A tool with no entry takes its exposure from the server config. Local beats project beats user, per tool; project and local values apply only in a trusted folder.
configuration.team.leadModel.description: Model for the team lead agent. Leave empty to use the active panel model.
configuration.team.leadEffort.descriptio: Reasoning effort for the team lead agent. Leave empty to use the model default. Efforts unsupported by the resolved model are ignored.
configuration.team.implementorModel.desc: Model for implementor role specialists. Leave empty to use the active panel model.
configuration.team.implementorEffort.des: Reasoning effort for implementor role specialists. Leave empty to use the model default. Efforts unsupported by the resolved model are ignored.
configuration.team.reviewerModel.descrip: Model for reviewer role specialists. Leave empty to use the active panel model.
configuration.team.reviewerEffort.descri: Reasoning effort for reviewer role specialists. Leave empty to use the model default. Efforts unsupported by the resolved model are ignored.
configuration.background.model.descripti: Model for background work: chat titles, memory extraction, profile summaries, query expansion and the memory quality audit. Automatic uses the first signed-in model of Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Step 5 Preview and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. A chosen model whose provider is signed out pauses that work; it never falls back to another provider. The memory merge and rerank judges follow Memory: Judge instead. Applies from user settings only.
configuration.background.effort.descript: Reasoning effort for background work on a chosen model. Per job runs each job at its own level (titles and query expansion as low as the model allows, extraction, profiles and the audit at low). Ignored on Automatic. Applies from user settings only.
configuration.memory.judge.description: What judges memory contradictions and reranks memories. Automatic uses the first available classifier of Jev on TypeSafe, Jev on OpenRouter and GPT-6 Luna on the Decisions API (which needs the OpenAI API key as the active OpenAI credential), skipping one whose key was refused, and otherwise the first signed-in model of Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Step 5 Preview and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. A chosen classifier or model that cannot run leaves merges and reranks waiting; it never falls back to another judge. Applies from user settings only.
configuration.memory.judgeEffort.descrip: Reasoning effort for a model chosen as the memory judge. Per job runs merges and reranks as low as the model allows. Ignored on Automatic and for a classifier. Applies from user settings only.
configuration.explore.model.description: Model for the Explore subagent. Default uses the small model of the chat's provider (Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, or a key provider's own small model) at medium effort, and the chat's own model at the chat's effort when that small model is signed out or outside pi's enabledModels. A chosen model whose provider is signed out, or which is outside pi's enabledModels, makes Explore fail with an error naming this setting; it never falls back to another model. Applies from user settings only.
configuration.explore.effort.description: Reasoning effort for the Explore subagent on a chosen model. Default runs at medium; on a model without medium, pi uses the next level up it supports, else the highest one. Ignored on Default. Applies from user settings only.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: In a restricted workspace, Damocles withholds everything the repository itself authors: project skills, project slash commands, project subagents, MCP servers defined in the repository, the repository AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md instructions file, the repository's pi configuration under .pi/ (packages and shell settings in .pi/settings.json, extensions, skills, prompts, and APPEND_SYSTEM.md), and the permission rules in the repository's .damocles/settings*.json and .claude/settings*.json files. Your own user-scope skills, commands, agents, instructions, and permission rules still load. Granting trust loads the project ones with no window reload. The two permission settings and the Compass toggle also ignore any value the repository sets, because a repository could use them to switch the permission gate off or to start indexing its own files.
